about_the_game:
Important notice before purchase!

The average frame rate for gaming varies between 40-70 frames depending on the performance of your computer!

Optimize the dual rendering pipeline, enable the use of the author's custom SRP rendering effects to maximize performance, and disable the use of Unity HDRP for frame rate improvement.

The average frame rate for gaming varies between 75-110 frames depending on the performance of your computer!

Since the game is developed using the Unity engine instead of Unreal Engine, this optimization is almost the ultimate for Unity graphics and optimization that a single person can achieve.

Purchase notice! Please purchase according to your own affordability. If you don't like the small game priced at a few dollars, you can get a refund.

Therefore, leaving a negative review seems somewhat deliberate.Thank you for your understanding.Any other opinions or insults are acceptable.

💡⭐【Game Notes】⭐

❓ Is the game a pay-to-play title with in-app purchases? Is it a single-player game, or can it be played online?

✅ Yes, it’s a 💟 pay-to-play game with no in-app purchases at all, offering a complete 🎮 single-player experience. Online MODs are also available, allowing you to play with friends 👬 online. Once you purchase the game, you can enjoy it permanently.

❓ What are the minimum and recommended system requirements for the game?

✅ The minimum requirements are a 🕹️ graphics card at least as powerful as the RTX 1060, along with 8GB of RAM. For a smoother experience, it is recommended to use a 🕹️ RTX 2060 or a higher-end graphics card and at least 16GB of RAM.

❓ Why do the game’s scenes seem to span multiple eras?

✅ The game is set in a 🊙️ mysterious space that travels through different eras. The stories and scenes within this space are based on real historical events related to human greed; in addition, players can freely explore the map, which represents the era in which the investigator is located – that is, the post-apocalyptic world where the investigator operates.

❓ Does the game have any mission maps?

✅ The game features uniquely designed PVE combat missions that require players to find their own solutions. Each mission allows players to collect unique 🏆 mysterious objects.

❓ Is there any free exploration in the game?

✅ Yes, the game features an open-world map that players can freely explore. This map represents the post-apocalyptic world in which the investigator operates.

❓ What are these 🏆 mysterious objects?

✅ These mysterious objects are a type of collectible. Each one possesses a unique 🔥 ability; owning them can give you significant advantages in the game!

❓ What types of weapons are available in the game, and can players use scopes?

✅ The game offers a variety of weapons, including pistols, revolvers, machine guns, rifles, sniper rifles, and shotguns. Scopes are also available, and their effects on gameplay have been carefully implemented.

❓ How many female protagonists are there currently in the game?

✅ There are currently 4 different 💟 female protagonists, each with their own unique 🔮 combat skills and growth paths. Players need to collect resources to level up their protagonists 💎 and enjoy the process of their growth.

❓ What are the plans for future theme updates? What aspects will be updated?

✅ With each update, new 💟 limited-time female protagonists and their corresponding weapons will be introduced, along with new mission maps. Buy them as soon as possible to get more female protagonists!

❓ Are there any elements related to “seething” or intense action in the game?

✅ Due to regulatory reasons, some content and gameplay elements related to such elements had to be removed from the game.

❓ Will the game be updated regularly?

✅ Yes, the game is planned to be updated regularly. In addition to the theme updates mentioned above, regular updates will also include: ① New mysterious objects and their abilities; ② Different types of weapons; ② Cool 💟 skins for the female protagonists; ③ Collectibles, achievements, 🚗 new vehicles, as well as new single-player and online gameplay modes.

❓ How long did it take to develop the game, and how large was the development team?

✅ The game was developed starting in 2022 and took nearly 4 years to complete. 💟 The entire development was done by me alone; there was no development team. So, the game is of high quality and offers an amazing gaming experience! 🌸

Join the player Q-group to receive extra benefits: 303276098

**Game Overview:**

You are an investigator assigned by your company to investigate strange events occurring in mysterious spaces and retrieve any abnormal objects found there. Of course, everything you collect during the mission becomes yours. Your company might turn a blind eye, but is life really that simple?

**Gameplay:**

This is a third-person game where players fight against mysterious invasions. It combines elements such as shooting, skill-based combat, exploration, PVE combat, free survival, vehicle driving, and character customization to create a brand-new 【PVE combat and shooting evacuation】 gameplay experience.

**Online Fun:**

You can play online with friends, explore together, and fight against mysterious invasions! Experience a whole new level of fun!

**Game Features:**

- 4 unique female protagonists, each with different weapons, skills, and outfits.

- Each protagonist offers 11 unique skills, suitable for players of all types.

- Each protagonist has a unique weapon with carefully tuned handling and gameplay mechanics.

- Intense PVE combat missions on independent maps – explore and retrieve resources!

- Vehicle driving fun.

- An open-world map for free exploration.

- Mysterious objects with unique 🔥 abilities; collect them to enhance your abilities!

- 3 independent PVE combat maps – find your solutions and retrieve resources to escape. Of course, the mysterious creatures will try their best to stop you from leaving the 🊙️ mysterious space.

- **Free Exploration Map:** When you want to relax and enjoy the scenery, the game offers a free exploration map. Each time you open the map, it looks completely different!
